title: Your keys, your way
blurb: Presets for tmux, screen and zellij, actions by name, every key.

greet: Your keys, your rules. Let us try a few presets.
Hi. Keys from tmux, screen or zellij, one menu away.
finish: Any preset, any action by name. The keys are yours now.

steps.title: Open the keybind presets
steps.note: Each preset gives you the keys of another multiplexer.

steps.title: Try the screen keys
steps.note: The panel says which keys your programs lose. Screen's leader is ctrl+a.
steps.hint: Press down twice to screen, then enter.

steps.title: Split the screen way
steps.note: ctrl+a, then shift+s, as in screen.
steps.hint: Hold ctrl and tap a, let go. Then shift+s.

steps.title: Hop with tab
steps.note: ctrl+a, then tab moves to the next region.

steps.title: Back to the tuios keys
steps.note: Every preset is a row in the palette too.
steps.hint: ctrl+p, type preset, enter. Up twice to tuios, then enter.

steps.title: Run any action by name
steps.note: In the palette, # searches every action and shows its keys.
steps.hint: ctrl+p, type #zoom, then enter on Toggle zoom.

steps.title: Every key in one list
steps.note: Search it with /. Esc closes it.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then k. Look around, then esc.
